**Finding: missing (medium severity) — transition assistance and data return.**

**What I checked:** Section 11 (Term and Termination), Section 12 (Source Code Escrow), the definitions section, and text searches for "transition" and "data" across the whole agreement.

**What exists:** Section 11.3 gives Corio meaningful post-termination continuity — surviving access rights for then-existing Customers, surviving Commerce One support and maintenance (so long as Corio keeps paying), and a carve-out letting Corio retain Confidential Information needed to support its Customers. Section 12 provides source code escrow on defined Release Conditions. All of that benefits us and was left alone.

**The gap:** Nothing anywhere requires Commerce One to provide exit/transition assistance or to return Corio and Customer data held in connection with the MarketSite.net Service, in any format or on any timeline, and there is no deletion/certification mechanic. The 11.3 return-or-destroy language covers Confidential Information only, not a usable data export.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 11.4 inserted after p0098 at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of data in a commonly used machine-readable format, then deletion with written certification, subject to legal retention. The comment offers the 90-day fallback if six months is resisted.
